"""Author controlled C10374 safety-zone Native requests; no legal outcome."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.parent.parent
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
LAW = 'No vehicle shall at any time be driven through or within a safety zone.'
POLICIES = {'primary': (8.0, 'standard', None),
            'fallback1': (5.0, 'standard', None),
            'fallback2': (8.0, 'elevated_overview', None),
            'fallback3': (8.0, 'standard', 35.0)}
CASES = ('selected_c5852cfd__condition_a', 'selected_c5852cfd__condition_b')
ZONE = (40.0, 60.0, -3.5, 0.0)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')


def put_rows(path, values):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)+'\n'
                            for row in values))


def road():
    return '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<lanes><laneSection s="0"><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="yellow" width="0.15"/></lane></center><right>
<lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane>
<lane id="-2" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane>
</right></laneSection></lanes><objects/><signals/></road></OpenDRIVE>
'''


def build():
    assignment = ROOT/'inputs'/CASE.name/'assignment.json'
    frozen = json.loads(assignment.read_text())
    plan = json.loads((CASE/'case-plan.json').read_text())
    if (frozen['law_record']['text'] != LAW or plan['source_law']['text'] != LAW or
            frozen['cell']['layout'] != 'alley' or
            frozen['cell']['control'] != 'safety_zone' or
            frozen['actor'] != 'motor_vehicle_driver'):
        raise ValueError('frozen safety-zone source or cell differs')
    road_path = HERE/'alley-zone.xodr'
    road_path.write_text(road())
    entries = []
    for suffix, through in ((CASES[0], True), (CASES[1], False)):
        for candidate, (speed, camera, stop) in POLICIES.items():
            target = HERE/'drafts'/suffix/candidate
            case_id = CASE.name+'__'+suffix
            values = []
            for frame in range(240):
                t = (frame+1)/20
                x = min(stop if stop is not None else 150, 5+speed*t)
                y = -1.75 if through else -5.25
                values.append({'frame': frame, 'time_s': t,
                    'case_id': case_id, 'candidate_id': candidate,
                    'source_kind': 'authored_native_request',
                    'requested_ego_x_m': round(x, 6), 'requested_ego_y_m': y,
                    'requested_lane_id': -1 if through else -2,
                    'zone_x_min_m': ZONE[0], 'zone_x_max_m': ZONE[1],
                    'zone_y_min_m': ZONE[2], 'zone_y_max_m': ZONE[3],
                    'requested_zone_route': through,
                    'physical_zone_designation_verified': False,
                    'actual_zone_overlap_observed': False,
                    'legal_verdict': None})
            tracks = target/'requested-tracks.jsonl'
            put_rows(tracks, values)
            config = {'format': 'c10374-safety-zone-native-request-v1',
                'assignment_id': CASE.name, 'case_id': case_id,
                'candidate_id': candidate,
                'source_branch': 'NRS 484B.110', 'source_text': LAW,
                'assignment_sha256': sha(assignment),
                'case_plan_sha256': sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
                'road_sha256': sha(road_path), 'tracks_sha256': sha(tracks),
                'rate_hz': 20, 'frames': 240,
                'requested_ego_speed_mps': speed, 'camera_policy': camera,
                'stop_x_m': stop, 'zone_rectangle_xy_m': list(ZONE),
                'requested_zone_route': through,
                'physical_zone_designation_verified': False,
                'actual_zone_overlap_observed': False,
                'original_native_observed': False,
                'status': 'unselected_native_request'}
            put(target/'config.json', config)
            entries.append({'case_id': case_id, 'candidate_id': candidate,
                            'config_sha256': sha(target/'config.json'),
                            'tracks_sha256': sha(tracks),
                            'status': 'unselected_native_request'})
    manifest = {'format': 'c10374-safety-zone-native-construction-v1',
        'assignment_id': CASE.name, 'assignment_sha256': sha(assignment),
        'case_plan_sha256': sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
        'road_sha256': sha(road_path),
        'capture_sha256': sha(HERE/'capture.py'),
        'measurement_contract_sha256': sha(HERE/'measurement-contract.json'),
        'saved_sha256': sha(HERE/'saved.py'),
        'fixture_raw_sha256': sha(HERE/'fixture_raw.py'),
        'route_fallbacks_sha256': sha(HERE/'route_fallbacks.py'),
        'entries': entries, 'original_native_observed': False,
        'delivery_ready': False}
    put(HERE/'manifest.json', manifest)
    return manifest


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps({'requests': len(build()['entries'])}))

"""Exact offline check of the authored C10374 zone comparison."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import CASES, LAW, POLICIES, ZONE


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    source = json.loads((bundle/'assignment-source.json').read_text())
    plan = json.loads((bundle/'case-plan.json').read_text())
    suffix = cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-2]+'__'+cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-1]
    candidate = cfg['candidate_id']
    if (suffix not in CASES or candidate not in POLICIES or
            cfg['case_id'] != cfg['assignment_id']+'__'+suffix or
            source['law_record']['text'] != LAW or
            plan['source_law']['text'] != LAW):
        raise ValueError('exact law/case source')
    if (cfg['assignment_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'assignment-source.json') or
            cfg['case_plan_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'case-plan.json') or
            cfg['road_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr') or
            cfg['tracks_sha256'] != sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')):
        raise ValueError('copied source hashes')
    root = ET.parse(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr').getroot()
    roads = root.findall('./road')
    if len(roads) != 1 or roads[0].get('id') != '374' or \
       [(lane.get('id'), lane.get('type')) for lane in roads[0].findall('./lanes/laneSection/right/lane')] != \
           [('-1','driving'),('-2','driving')]:
        raise ValueError('alley lane topology')
    speed,camera,stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    through = suffix == CASES[0]
    if (cfg['requested_zone_route'] is not through or
            cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps'] != speed or cfg['camera_policy'] != camera or
            cfg['stop_x_m'] != stop or cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'] != list(ZONE) or
            cfg['physical_zone_designation_verified'] is not False or
            cfg['actual_zone_overlap_observed'] is not False):
        raise ValueError('candidate policy or unverified zone status')
    tracks = rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    if len(tracks) != 240:
        raise ValueError('240-frame request')
    encounter = 0
    for i,row in enumerate(tracks):
        t=(i+1)/20
        x=round(min(stop if stop is not None else 150,5+speed*t),6)
        y=-1.75 if through else -5.25
        if (row['frame'] != i or row['time_s'] != t or
                row['requested_ego_x_m'] != x or row['requested_ego_y_m'] != y or
                row['requested_lane_id'] != (-1 if through else -2) or
                row['requested_zone_route'] is not through or
                row['physical_zone_designation_verified'] is not False or
                row['actual_zone_overlap_observed'] is not False):
            raise ValueError('request row differs')
        encounter += int(ZONE[0] <= x <= ZONE[1])
    if candidate == 'fallback3' and encounter != 0 or \
       candidate != 'fallback3' and encounter == 0:
        raise ValueError('pass/stop request geometry')
    return {'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':candidate,
            'requested_zone_route':through,'requested_encounter_frames':encounter,
            'actual_zone_overlap_observed':False,'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,default=Path.cwd())
    a=p.parse_args();print(json.dumps(check(a.bundle)))

            'center_native_xyz_m':[transform.location.x,transform.location.y,transform.location.z],

    bundle=Path(bundle).resolve();output=Path(output).resolve()
    checked=check(bundle);cfg=json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    requests=[json.loads(line) for line in (bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    client=carla.Client(host,int(port));client.set_timeout(180)
    prior=client.get_world();saved=snapshot(client)
    if prior.get_settings().synchronous_mode or any(
            actor.type_id.startswith(('vehicle.','walker.','sensor.'))
            for actor in prior.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('Exclusive idle asynchronous CARLA world required')
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    owned=[];encoders={};logs={};queues={};pipeline=None
    changed=False;frames=0;error=None;restored=None;lanes_verified=False
    try:
        world=client.generate_opendrive_world((bundle/'alley-zone.xodr').read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(vertex_distance=.25,max_road_length=50,
                wall_height=0,additional_width=0,smooth_junctions=False,
                enable_mesh_visibility=True,enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed=True
        settings=world.get_settings();settings.synchronous_mode=True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds=.05;settings.substepping=True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time=.01;settings.max_substeps=10
        world.apply_settings(settings);world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        mapping=world.get_map();lane_rows={}
        for lane,y in ((-1,-1.75),(-2,-5.25)):
            wp=mapping.get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=50,y=y,z=1),
                project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
            lane_rows[str(lane)]=None if wp is None else {'road_id':wp.road_id,'lane_id':wp.lane_id}
            if wp is None or wp.road_id!=374 or wp.lane_id!=lane:
                raise RuntimeError('Generated alley lane differs')
        lanes_verified=True
        bp=world.get_blueprint_library().find('vehicle.tesla.model3')
        bp.set_attribute('role_name','c10374_ego')
        first=requests[0]
        ego=world.try_spawn_actor(bp,carla.Transform(carla.Location(
            x=first['requested_ego_x_m'],y=first['requested_ego_y_m'],z=1.5)))
        if ego is None:raise RuntimeError('C10374 ego spawn failed')
        owned.append(ego)
        marker_options=sorted((item for item in world.get_blueprint_library().filter('static.prop.*')
            if 'bollard' in item.id or 'streetbarrier' in item.id),key=lambda item:item.id)
        if not marker_options:
            raise RuntimeError('No Native physical zone delimiter blueprint available')
        zone_markers=[]
        for x,y in ((40,-3.4),(40,-.1),(60,-3.4),(60,-.1)):
            marker=world.try_spawn_actor(marker_options[0],carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(x=x,y=y,z=.2),carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
            if marker is None:
                raise RuntimeError('Native zone delimiter spawn failed')
            owned.append(marker)
            pose=marker.get_transform().location
            zone_markers.append({'actor_id':marker.id,'blueprint':marker.type_id,

        elevated=cfg['camera_policy']=='elevated_overview'
        specs=(('overview',1280,720,100 if elevated else 85,
                (50,-12,45 if elevated else 30),-70 if elevated else -60),
               ('forward',1280,720,90,(1,0,1.5),0))
        for name,width,height,fov,location,pitch in specs:
            camera_bp=world.get_blueprint_library().find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            for key,value in (('image_size_x',width),('image_size_y',height),
                              ('fov',fov),('sensor_tick',0)):
                camera_bp.set_attribute(key,str(value))
            camera=world.spawn_actor(camera_bp,carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(*location),carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch)),
                attach_to=ego if name=='forward' else None)
            owned.append(camera);queues[name]=queue.Queue();camera.listen(queues[name].put)
            logs[name]=(output/(name+'.encoder.log')).open('x')
            encoders[name]=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-hide_banner',
                '-loglevel','error','-n','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-s',
                f'{width}x{height}','-r','20','-i','pipe:0','-an','-c:v','ffv1',
                str(output/(name+'.mkv'))],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=logs[name])
        put_new(output/'native-map-readback.json',{
            'source_kind':'original_native','road_sha256':sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr'),
            'native_map_sha256':hashlib.sha256(mapping.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest(),
            'lane_readback':lane_rows,'ego_actor_id':ego.id,
            'generated_alley_lanes_verified':lanes_verified,
            'native_zone_delimiters':zone_markers,
            'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
            'zone_rectangle_xy_m':cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'],
            'legal_verdict':None})
        for _ in range(20):world.tick()
        pipeline=PipelineCapture(client,ego,output,cfg['case_id'],visibility=False)
        start=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
        with (output/'native-raw-actors.jsonl').open('x') as actors,\
             (output/'video_frames.jsonl').open('x') as videos:
            for i,requested in enumerate(requests):
                current=ego.get_transform()
                speed=cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps']
                if cfg['stop_x_m'] is not None and current.location.x >= cfg['stop_x_m']-speed*.05:
                    speed=0
                ego.set_target_velocity(carla.Vector3D(x=speed,y=0,z=0))
                frame=world.tick();time_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds-start
                pose=actor_pose(ego)
                wp=mapping.get_waypoint(ego.get_transform().location,
                    project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
                row={'frame':i,'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s,
                    'source_kind':'original_native','requested_ego_x_m':requested['requested_ego_x_m'],
                    'requested_ego_y_m':requested['requested_ego_y_m'],
                    'ego':pose,'observed_road_id':None if wp is None else wp.road_id,
                    'observed_lane_id':None if wp is None else wp.lane_id,
                    'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
                    'actual_zone_overlap_observed':False,'legal_verdict':None}
                actors.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                pipeline.capture(frame,time_s,extra={'c10374_safety_zone':row})
                for name,width,height,_,_,_ in specs:
                    image=queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<frame:image=queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=frame:raise RuntimeError('Native/video frame join failed')
                    rgb=np.frombuffer(image.raw_data,dtype=np.uint8).reshape(height,width,4)[:,:,:3][:,:,::-1]
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                videos.write(json.dumps({'video_frame':i,'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s})+'\n')
                frames+=1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:
            try:pipeline.close(confirmed=error is None)
            except BaseException as exc:error=error or {'capture_close_error':str(exc)}
        for name,encoder in encoders.items():
            try:
                encoder.stdin.close()
                if encoder.wait(timeout=180)!=0:raise RuntimeError('FFV1 encoder failed')
            except BaseException as exc:error=error or {'encoder_error':str(exc)}
            logs[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith('sensor.') and actor.is_listening:actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:error=error or {'cleanup_error':str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:restored=restore(client,saved)
            except BaseException as exc:error=error or {'restore_error':str(exc)}
        put_new(output/'native-capture-report.json',{
            'case_id':checked['case_id'],'candidate_id':checked['candidate_id'],
            'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
            'requested_frames':240,'observed_frames':frames,
            'restoration':restored,'error':error,'accepted':False,
            'generated_alley_lanes_verified':lanes_verified,
            'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
            'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False})
    if error:raise RuntimeError('C10374 Native attempt failed; see capture report')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,default=Path.cwd())
    p.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--host',default='localhost');p.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000)
    a=p.parse_args()
    if a.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(a.bundle)))
    else:
        if a.output_dir is None:raise ValueError('Original Native output directory required')
        capture(a.bundle,a.output_dir,a.host,a.port)

"""Source-bound raw preparation and moving footprint/zone overlap measurement."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from check import check

RAW=('native-map-readback.json','native-raw-actors.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl',
     'frame-review.jsonl','native-capture-report.json')
SAVED=('native-observed.jsonl','camera-frames.jsonl','frame-review.jsonl')
MARKERS=((40,-3.4),(40,-.1),(60,-3.4),(60,-.1))


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def rows(path):return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
def require(ok,message):
    if not ok:raise ValueError(message)
def finite(value):return type(value) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(value)


def media_hashes(raw,synthetic):
    if synthetic:return {}
    result={}
    for name in ('forward.mkv','overview.mkv'):
        result[name]=sha(raw/name)
        process=subprocess.run(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames',
            '-select_streams','v:0','-show_entries','stream=codec_name,nb_read_frames',
            '-of','json',str(raw/name)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=120)
        streams=json.loads(process.stdout).get('streams',[])
        require(len(streams)==1 and streams[0].get('codec_name')=='ffv1' and
                streams[0].get('nb_read_frames')=='240','original FFV1 frames')
    return result


def validate_vehicle(ego,actor_id):
    require(type(ego) is dict and ego.get('actor_id')==actor_id and
            ego.get('blueprint')=='vehicle.tesla.model3','ego identity')
    center=ego.get('center_native_xyz_m');velocity=ego.get('velocity_native_xyz_mps')
    body=ego.get('body_native_xyz_m')
    require(type(center) is list and len(center)==3 and all(map(finite,center)) and
            type(velocity) is list and len(velocity)==3 and all(map(finite,velocity)) and
            finite(ego.get('speed_mps')) and ego['speed_mps']>=0 and
            abs(math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in velocity))-ego['speed_mps'])<.01 and
            type(body) is list and len(body)==8 and
            all(type(p) is list and len(p)==3 and all(map(finite,p)) for p in body),
            'finite ego pose/body/speed')
    xs=[p[0] for p in body];ys=[p[1] for p in body]
    require(3<=max(xs)-min(xs)<=7 and 1.3<=max(ys)-min(ys)<=7 and
            abs((max(xs)+min(xs))/2-center[0])<1 and
            abs((max(ys)+min(ys))/2-center[1])<1,
            'ego body geometry')


def prepare(bundle,raw,output,synthetic=False):
    bundle,raw,output=map(Path,(bundle,raw,output))
    checked=check(bundle);cfg=read(bundle/'config.json')
    require(not output.exists(),'saved output must be fresh')
    hashes={name:sha(raw/name) for name in RAW}
    mapping=read(raw/RAW[0]);report=read(raw/RAW[-1])
    actors=rows(raw/RAW[1]);videos=rows(raw/RAW[2]);reviews=rows(raw/RAW[3])
    requested=rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    kind='synthetic_cpu' if synthetic else 'original_native'
    require(len(actors)==len(videos)==len(reviews)==len(requested)==240,
            '240 raw joins')
    markers=mapping.get('native_zone_delimiters')
    require(mapping.get('source_kind')==kind and
            mapping.get('road_sha256')==sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr') and
            type(mapping.get('native_map_sha256')) is str and
            len(mapping['native_map_sha256'])==64 and
            mapping.get('lane_readback')=={
                str(lane):{'road_id':374,'lane_id':lane} for lane in (-1,-2)} and
            mapping.get('generated_alley_lanes_verified') is True and
            mapping.get('zone_rectangle_xy_m')==cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'] and
            type(mapping.get('ego_actor_id')) is int and
            type(markers) is list and len(markers)==4 and
            len({m.get('actor_id') for m in markers})==4 and
            all(type(m.get('actor_id')) is int and
                type(m.get('blueprint')) is str and
                ('bollard' in m['blueprint'] or 'streetbarrier' in m['blueprint']) and
                type(m.get('xyz_m')) is list and len(m['xyz_m'])==3 and
                all(map(finite,m['xyz_m'])) and
                abs(m['xyz_m'][0]-MARKERS[i][0])<.5 and
                abs(m['xyz_m'][1]-MARKERS[i][1])<.5
                for i,m in enumerate(markers)) and
            mapping.get('physical_zone_designation_verified') is False and
            mapping.get('legal_verdict') is None,'generated road and delimiter binding')
    require(report.get('case_id')==checked['case_id'] and
            report.get('candidate_id')==checked['candidate_id'] and
            report.get('config_sha256')==sha(bundle/'config.json') and
            report.get('requested_frames')==report.get('observed_frames')==240 and
            report.get('error') is None and report.get('accepted') is False and
            report.get('delivery_ready') is False and
            report.get('generated_alley_lanes_verified') is True and
            report.get('physical_zone_designation_verified') is False and
            report.get('legal_verdict') is None,'unaccepted capture report')
    media=media_hashes(raw,synthetic)
    first=actors[0].get('native_frame')
    require(type(first) is int,'first Native frame')
    observed=[];camera=[]
    for i,(row,video,review,request) in enumerate(zip(actors,videos,reviews,requested)):
        native=first+i;t=row.get('time_s')
        require(row.get('frame')==i and row.get('native_frame')==native and
                row.get('source_kind')==kind and finite(t) and
                abs(t-(i+1)/20)<.005 and
                row.get('requested_ego_x_m')==request['requested_ego_x_m'] and
                row.get('requested_ego_y_m')==request['requested_ego_y_m'] and
                row.get('observed_road_id')==374 and
                row.get('observed_lane_id')==request['requested_lane_id'] and
                row.get('physical_zone_designation_verified') is False and
                row.get('actual_zone_overlap_observed') is False and
                row.get('legal_verdict') is None,f'actor/request join {i}')
        validate_vehicle(row.get('ego'),mapping['ego_actor_id'])
        require(video.get('video_frame')==i and video.get('native_frame')==native and
                finite(video.get('time_s')) and abs(video['time_s']-t)<1e-6 and
                review.get('frame')==i and review.get('native_frame')==native and
                finite(review.get('time_s')) and abs(review['time_s']-t)<1e-6 and
                review.get('source_kind')==kind and
                review.get('review_provenance')==(
                    'synthetic_cpu' if synthetic else 'human_frame_review') and
                review.get('forward_video_sha256')==media.get('forward.mkv','synthetic_cpu') and
                review.get('overview_video_sha256')==media.get('overview.mkv','synthetic_cpu') and
                type(review.get('zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed')) is bool and
                (type(review.get('zone_boundary_visible')) is bool
                 if review['zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed'] else
                 review.get('zone_boundary_visible') is None),f'video/review join {i}')
        observed.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t,
                         'source_kind':kind,'ego':row['ego'],
                         'observed_lane_id':row['observed_lane_id']})
        camera.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'video_frame':i,
                       'time_s':t,'source_kind':kind})
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name,data in zip(SAVED,(observed,camera,reviews)):
        (output/name).write_text(''.join(json.dumps(item,allow_nan=False)+'\n' for item in data))
    receipt={'format':'c10374-zone-raw-to-saved-v1',
        'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':cfg['candidate_id'],
        'source_kind':kind,'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
        'raw_hashes':hashes,'media_hashes':media,
        'saved_hashes':{name:sha(output/name) for name in SAVED},
        'original_native_observed':not synthetic,
        'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
        'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False}
    (output/'preparation-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    return receipt


def measure(bundle,saved):
    bundle,saved=map(Path,(bundle,saved));check(bundle)
    cfg=read(bundle/'config.json');receipt=read(saved/'preparation-receipt.json')
    observations,cameras,reviews=(rows(saved/name) for name in SAVED)
    require(receipt.get('config_sha256')==sha(bundle/'config.json') and
            receipt.get('source_kind') in ('synthetic_cpu','original_native') and
            receipt.get('original_native_observed')==(receipt['source_kind']=='original_native') and
            receipt.get('physical_zone_designation_verified') is False and
            receipt.get('legal_verdict') is None and receipt.get('delivery_ready') is False and
            all(receipt['saved_hashes'][name]==sha(saved/name) for name in SAVED) and
            len(observations)==len(cameras)==len(reviews)==240,'prepared source and joins')
    xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax=cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m']
    moving_overlap=reviewed=visible=0
    first_overlap=None;last_overlap=None
    for i,(row,cam,review) in enumerate(zip(observations,cameras,reviews)):
        require(row['frame']==cam['frame']==review['frame']==i and
                row['native_frame']==cam['native_frame']==review['native_frame'] and
                row['source_kind']==cam['source_kind']==review['source_kind']==receipt['source_kind'],
                f'prepared frame {i}')
        body=row['ego']['body_native_xyz_m'];xs=[p[0] for p in body];ys=[p[1] for p in body]
        overlap=max(xs)>=xmin and min(xs)<=xmax and max(ys)>=ymin and min(ys)<=ymax
        if overlap and row['ego']['speed_mps']>.1:
            moving_overlap+=1
            if first_overlap is None:first_overlap=i
            last_overlap=i
        reviewed+=int(review['zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed'])
        visible+=int(review['zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed'] and
                     review['zone_boundary_visible'] is True)
    return {'format':'c10374-zone-prepared-measurement-v1',
        'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':cfg['candidate_id'],
        'source_kind':receipt['source_kind'],
        'requested_zone_route':cfg['requested_zone_route'],
        'moving_body_rectangle_overlap_frames':moving_overlap,
        'first_moving_overlap_frame':first_overlap,
        'last_moving_overlap_frame':last_overlap,
        'reviewed_boundary_frames':reviewed,
        'reviewed_visible_boundary_frames':visible,
        'authored_rectangle_is_designated_zone':False,
        'original_native_observed':receipt['original_native_observed'],
        'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--raw-folder',type=Path);p.add_argument('--saved-folder',type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--synthetic-cpu',action='store_true');a=p.parse_args()
    if a.raw_folder:print(json.dumps(prepare(a.bundle,a.raw_folder,a.saved_folder,a.synthetic_cpu)))
    else:print(json.dumps(measure(a.bundle,a.saved_folder)))

"""Raw-shaped synthetic CPU diagnostic; never an original zone observation."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from build import put,put_rows,sha


def vehicle(x,y,v):
    corners=((x-2,y-.9),(x-2,y+.9),(x+2,y+.9),(x+2,y-.9))
    return {'actor_id':101,'blueprint':'vehicle.tesla.model3',
        'center_native_xyz_m':[x,y,1.5],
        'velocity_native_xyz_mps':[v,0,0], 'speed_mps':v,
        'body_native_xyz_m':[[round(px,6),round(py,6),z]
                              for z in (.5,2.5) for px,py in corners]}


def build(bundle,output):
    bundle,output=map(Path,(bundle,output))
    if output.exists():raise ValueError('raw output must be fresh')
    cfg=json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    requests=[json.loads(line) for line in (bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    markers=[{'actor_id':200+i,'blueprint':'static.prop.streetbarrier',
              'xyz_m':[x,y,.2]} for i,(x,y) in enumerate(
                  ((40,-3.4),(40,-.1),(60,-3.4),(60,-.1)))]
    put(output/'native-map-readback.json',{
        'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','road_sha256':sha(bundle/'alley-zone.xodr'),
        'native_map_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'synthetic-c10374-road374').hexdigest(),
        'lane_readback':{str(lane):{'road_id':374,'lane_id':lane} for lane in (-1,-2)},
        'ego_actor_id':101,'generated_alley_lanes_verified':True,
        'native_zone_delimiters':markers,'zone_rectangle_xy_m':cfg['zone_rectangle_xy_m'],
        'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,'legal_verdict':None})
    actors=[];videos=[];reviews=[]
    for i,request in enumerate(requests):
        x,y=request['requested_ego_x_m'],request['requested_ego_y_m']
        previous=requests[i-1]['requested_ego_x_m'] if i else x
        speed=round((x-previous)*20,6)
        native=i+1000;t=request['time_s']
        actors.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t,
            'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','requested_ego_x_m':x,'requested_ego_y_m':y,
            'ego':vehicle(x,y,speed), 'observed_road_id':374,
            'observed_lane_id':request['requested_lane_id'],
            'physical_zone_designation_verified':False,
            'actual_zone_overlap_observed':False,'legal_verdict':None})
        videos.append({'video_frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t})
        reviews.append({'frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':t,
            'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','review_provenance':'synthetic_cpu',
            'forward_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu','overview_video_sha256':'synthetic_cpu',
            'zone_boundary_pixel_reviewed':False,
            'zone_boundary_visible':None})

"""Route measured zone fallback eligibility without choosing a delivery case."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from saved import measure


def route(bundle,saved):
    m=measure(bundle,saved)
    overlap=m['moving_body_rectangle_overlap_frames']
    mismatch=(overlap==0 if m['requested_zone_route'] else overlap>0)
    return {'format':'c10374-zone-measured-routing-v1',
        'case_id':m['case_id'],'candidate_id':m['candidate_id'],
        'source_kind':m['source_kind'],
        'triggers':{
            'fallback1':{'eligible':mismatch,
                'moving_body_rectangle_overlap_frames':overlap,
                'reason':'observed moving body/rectangle relation differs from target'},
            'fallback2':{'eligible':m['reviewed_boundary_frames']<240 or
                         m['reviewed_visible_boundary_frames']<1,
                'reviewed_boundary_frames':m['reviewed_boundary_frames'],
                'reason':'incomplete reviewed safety-zone boundary visibility'},
            'fallback3':{'eligible':not m['original_native_observed'] or
                         m['authored_rectangle_is_designated_zone'] is False,
                'original_native_observed':m['original_native_observed'],
                'reason':'missing original Native or authoritative zone designation'}},
        'selected_fallback':None,'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--saved',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(route(a.bundle,a.saved)))

import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from check import check
from fixture_raw import build as fixture
from saved import prepare, measure
from route_fallbacks import route

class ExactSafetyZone(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_source_and_unverified_physics(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        self.assertFalse(result['actual_zone_overlap_observed'])
        self.assertFalse(result['delivery_ready'])
        self.assertEqual(result['requested_zone_route'],
                         result['case_id'].endswith('condition_a'))

    def test_distinct_stop_request(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        if result['candidate_id']=='fallback3':
            self.assertEqual(result['requested_encounter_frames'],0)
        else:
            self.assertGreater(result['requested_encounter_frames'],0)

    def test_synthetic_raw_to_saved_overlap(self):
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root=Path(folder)
            fixture(Path.cwd(),root/'raw')
            receipt=prepare(Path.cwd(),root/'raw',root/'saved',True)
            measurement=measure(Path.cwd(),root/'saved')
            routed=route(Path.cwd(),root/'saved')
            self.assertEqual(receipt['source_kind'],'synthetic_cpu')
            self.assertFalse(measurement['authored_rectangle_is_designated_zone'])
            self.assertFalse(measurement['delivery_ready'])
            self.assertIsNone(routed['selected_fallback'])
